full_details: In the parlour the company ran Richard the Third from the rolls for next week. Each man had his own speeches and three cue-words. Garnish checked the entrances against the plot by the door. Cowley came in twice on the wrong lord, because two cues ended alike, and you changed three cue-words: Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. Larkham copied both rolls and did not speak. Nick had the words and not the breath before the door. Burbage did the wooing at half voice, and it was still too big for the room. Phillips asked you to give Egeon to Cowley. You would not. At two you got through the tale on breath and consonants. Kemp said, kindly, that you never sounded so near death. The Rose bill was Set at Maw. You did not go.
one_sentence: You changed three cues in the morning, and you played Egeon at two on breath and consonants.
title: Played Egeon on breath and consonants
